scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && tsup --config tsup.config.ts && npm run copy:static && npm run copy:manifest
scripts.dev: tsup --watch --config tsup.config.ts --onSuccess "npm run copy:static && npm run copy:manifest"
scripts.copy:static: mkdir -p dist/ui && cp src/ui/palette.html dist/ui/palette.html && cp src/ui/styles.css dist/ui/styles.css
